title: stroemia glandulosa
intro: Stroemia glandulosa, commonly known as False Ash, is a plant species in the family Annonaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the potential to support the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, and show antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions attributed to Stroemia glandulosa include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which may help in wound healing and skin disorders. The bioactive constituents of Stroemia glandulosa include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
